title: Finite locally free dual conormal on its rank stratum
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], with Y Noetherian. Suppose every z∈Z has an affine neighbourhood U of i(z) on which the kernel ideal [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is generated by a finite Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Let C be the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] of that kernel ideal to Z. Let r:Z→ℕ be locally constant and equal at each z to the finrank of the module stalk [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] of C. For each n∈ℕ the restriction of Hom(C,O_Z) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] to the open rank-n stratum [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex] is finite locally free of rank n [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module].

source.place: Tag 0BR0 (lemma-regular-immersion), normal sheaf and locally constant rank; Tag 0BQZ (lemma-regular-immersion-ext), local Koszul calculation

proof.text: At a point x of the rank-n stratum, obtain an affine neighbourhood U, a finite Koszul-regular generating family f indexed by Fin m, and its span equation from hregular. Apply exists_koszul_conormal_basis to obtain a basis b of the conormal module I/I^2 over A/I. Apply affine_conormal_frame i U m b to obtain a free frame of the conormal over V=i^{-1}(U) and the equality of its stalk finrank with m. Combine that equality with hr and the membership r(x)=n to obtain m=n, and rewrite the frame with this equality.

Apply the proved source-library overHomObjIso to restrict internal Hom to V, map the conormal frame contravariantly through homFunctor, and compose with homObjFreeUnitIso to obtain a free dual frame of size n. These are explicit finite dual-basis isomorphisms from WeilConjectures.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.InternalHomFree, without using any determinant or derived-duality theorem.

Choose these opens and frames for each point x of the rank stratum S. Their inverse images V_x under S.ι cover S because x lies in its own V_x. Convert over-frames to restriction frames with overIsoFreeEquiv, and restrict along S.ι restricted to the chosen open. The two restriction-composition comparisons and morphismRestrict_ι identify this with the restriction of the dual on S to V_x. Compose with restrictFreeIso and apply isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_restrict_iso_free. This proves the fixed-rank condition, including the empty cover on an empty S and the empty free basis when n=0.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulRegularImmersion_dual_conormal_rank_stratum {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z, r z = Module.finrank (Z.presheaf.stalk z)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n).ι).obj
      (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
        (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank n
